value.title: GAME ROOM 2.0 Phase 1: modular TypeScript client + multiplayer-ready contracts
value.excerpt:
## Summary
- Save previous release in `backup/phase1-2026-10-09`
- Isolate unchanged procedural party room to `PartyWorld` and port app/controller layer to TypeScript
- Preserve iPhone dual-touch movement, free-look, title scene, menu, jump, sound and object interactions
- Add typed player model, placeholder remote avatars, cryptographic room IDs and validated WebSocket transport interface (not connected)
- Introduce Vite build, GitHub Pages workflow, tests and architecture/regression documentation

## Important
This release remains **single-player/offline only**. Real-time server connectivity and two-device sync are deferred to Phase 2.

## Deployment
Change GitHub Settings → Pages → Source to **GitHub Actions** to deploy `dist/` to the existing `/game-room/` URL. Do **not** switch from branch publishing until the workflow checks pass.

## Validation
- CI: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`
- Real iPhone Safari regression still required
- Existing `main.js` retained and backup branch available.

Sourced from next's releases.

This release contains security fixes for the following advisories:

value.title: Add employee task attendance and completion sync
value.excerpt:
## Summary
- Add an employee-only `/attendance` page listing assigned tasks.
- Allow employees to confirm completion only for tasks assigned to their account name.
- Update `Task.status` to `Hoàn thành` and insert an `AttendanceLog` row in one SQL transaction.
- Add a non-destructive SQL migration for `AttendanceLog` and add an employee navigation link.

## Setup
Run `database/attendance_migration.sql` against `task_management_db` before deploying.

## Notes
The existing schema does not link `Account` and `Employee` by ID, so this implementation matches `Account.fullname` to `Employee.name`; those values must match exactly. This feature treats attendance as task-completion confirmation, not shift check-in/check-out.

## Validation
Files were checked from the feature branch; a full Maven/server/database integration test was not run in this environment.

value.title: fix(recording): make program registration portable
value.excerpt:
Make the optional program registration helper work on Linux and macOS without changing clock algorithms, locking, recording format or fail-open semantics.

Use pipe + FD_CLOEXEC, resolve the real monotonic clock during early initialization, and remove loader injection from the helper environment to avoid recursive injection. Accept DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES in the helper response.

Validation: Linux ARM64 native and amd64 emulation record/pack/replay; nine recording fail-open cases on each architecture; missing/nonzero/timeout helper cases; macOS ARM64 replay/thread/EOF. macOS helper first launch intermittently failed and unchanged retry passed, cause unresolved. macOS online recording is not enabled by the consumer. These exact source changes are already exercised by MindPowers PR #461.

value.title: Add product tags
value.excerpt:
## Summary
This pull request adds product tags to the Baby Tools World shop.

## Changes
- Add `Tag` model with `name`, `created_at` and `updated_at`
- Add optional ManyToMany `tags` field to `Product`
- Register `Tag` in the Django admin and add a tag filter to `ProductAdmin`
- Show product tags on the product detail page ("Product-Tags", or "no tags available" if empty)
- Load `SECRET_KEY` from environment variables
- Add flake8 configuration

## Still to do
- [x] Clear the review form after a successful submission
- [x] Update README (Quickstart, Usage, Docker)
- [x] Pin all package versions in `requirements.txt`

## How to test
1. Copy `example.env` to `.env` and set a `SECRET_KEY`
2. Run `python manage.py migrate`
3. Run `python manage.py runserver`
4. Create tags in the admin panel and assign them to a product
5. Open the product detail page and check the tags

## Summary
- Add `public/_redirects` so client-side React routes fall back to `index.html` on Cloudflare Pages.
- Remove `bun.lock` from this branch so Pages resolves dependencies consistently from the existing `package-lock.json`.
- Update `vite.config.ts` to resolve the project root from `import.meta.url` rather than relying on `__dirname` in ESM.

## Verification
- Reviewed the repository configuration and confirmed `npm run build` exists in `package.json`.
- Could not run `npm ci && npm run build` in the tool environment because outbound access to GitHub is unavailable.
- Do not switch the production domain or remove the existing Vercel deployment until the Pages preview deploy is verified.
